understandings.subject: Stale-image trap
understandings.description: Why does a green container 404 on a newly added endpoint?
understandings.statement: A healthy container is always fresh.
understandings.contentSummary: Superseded: v1 asserted freshness is guaranteed by a green health check.

understandings.subject: Stale-image trap
understandings.description: Why does a green container 404 on a newly added endpoint?
understandings.statement: A healthy container may run a stale build; verify freshness by calling a newly added endpoint.
understandings.contentSummary: Green health checks prove liveness, not freshness.

understandings.subject: Graph over joins
understandings.description: What is the graph store's relationship to relational joins?
understandings.statement: The graph is a path, not a join.
understandings.contentSummary: A relational join cannot express the chain from measurement to decision.

understandings.subject: Cache path
understandings.statement: Redis holds the cache, not the store.
understandings.contentSummary: The cache is not the store.
